summary: Agent rewritten in Rust (same protocol; update agents from the panel). Mail moves to Yunori Mail Server: migration 0003 drops mail_forwarders, mail_auth_checks and mail_log_entries and empties the mail domain, mailbox and alias tables; Postfix/Dovecot hosts are no longer managed. Security: single-use TOTP codes, X-Forwarded-For only from trusted proxies, checksum-verified agent installs. Plus alert rules, a finished DNS page and many fixes.
